# agentic-security-audit

> An agent-independent, coverage-led security audit skill for tracing untrusted AI agent context into execution authority and real system effects.

The package offers Lite scoped single-context reviews and Standard independent audits, using 12 invariants and 20 attack classes. Lite produces chat or a compact report; Standard uses the existing v4 JSON/Markdown bundle and Python helpers (Python 3.10+ and jsonschema). It investigates production-relevant effects and accepts equivalent controls that stop them; missing best practices are not vulnerabilities.

A candidate needs attacker-controlled input, a crossed trust boundary, a broken authoritative control and a reachable security effect. Pending candidates are distinct from independently adjudicated findings. Only confirmed findings receive severity. A completed selected pass is not a security certification. Independent contexts are required for independent verification.

Links below are relative to the repository root. A website publisher should preserve these routes or replace them with the actual public documentation URLs.

## Project overview

- [README](README.md): Definition, quick start, workflow, outputs and frequently asked questions.
- [Audit instructions](skills/agentic-security-audit/SKILL.md): Scope selection, source-to-effect investigation and completion rules.
- [Lite profile](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/lite-profile.md): Domain selection, self-challenge, compact report and bounded candidate escalation.
- [Standard profile](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/standard-profile.md): Existing v4 independent workflow, canonical artifacts and optional supplemental observations/containment notes.

## Audit references

- [Execution safety](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/execution-safety.md): OS-enforced target execution, output isolation and frozen source identity.

- [Security invariants](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/invariants.md): The 12 contracts used to guide source inspection.
- [OWASP Agentic Top 10 crosswalk](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/owasp-agentic-crosswalk.md): ASI01–ASI10 routes, scope limits and coverage-planning guidance.
- [Attack classes](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/attack-classes/INDEX.md): Routing for 20 scoped hunting guides.
- [Orchestration](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/orchestration.md): Hunter roles, context isolation and verifier/reviewer prompts.
- [Artifact contract](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/artifact-contract.md): Record fields, evidence requirements and helper commands.
- [Claim and evidence rules](skills/agentic-security-audit/references/claim-evidence.md): Threat models, composite chains, separate reachability, minimum evidence, assurance dimensions and optional signed host receipts.
- Candidate feature flags derive mandatory evidence; capability states and deployment receipts constrain attacker entry. Necessary refuted dependencies require rejection. Human action binding and observed persuasion have separate claim types.
- [Bundle schema](skills/agentic-security-audit/schemas/bundle.schema.json): Machine-readable structure for metadata, coverage, candidates and findings.
